label.purpose: Buttons, field labels, table headers, and status emphasis.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and compact control feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action within an action group.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#1f6feb; color:#fff; border:0; border-radius:4px; padding:8px 16px; font:600 13px system-ui; transition:background 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#1858c7; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1f6feb; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A compact supporting action without elevation.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background:#eef1f4; color:#1b1f24; border:1px solid #d0d7de; border-radius:4px; padding:8px 16px; font:600 13px system-ui; transition:border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:#1f6feb; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1f6feb; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: A familiar desktop field with explicit focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background:#fff; color:#1b1f24; border:1px solid #d0d7de; border-radius:4px; padding:6px 8px; font:400 13px system-ui; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:#1f6feb; outline:1px solid #1f6feb; } .ds-input:disabled { color:#5b6570; background:#eef1f4; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Semantic runtime state expressed by text and color.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-block; background:#dafbe1; color:#1a7f37; border-radius:4px; padding:2px 6px; font:600 13px system-ui; }

narrative.overview: Zarya uses restrained neutral layers and a single signal-blue accent so the current state and next safe action remain obvious. Desktop App Toolkit supplies interaction quality while Zarya keeps its own information architecture.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained neutral surfaces with one functional accent.
Compact system typography and predictable desktop density.
Clear semantic state labels that include text as well as color.
Short state transitions only; no decorative choreography.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue occupies at most a small minority of a screen and appears only where interaction or current state earns it.

rules.name: The Desktop Scale Rule
rules.body: Do not use oversized display typography; hierarchy comes from weight, grouping, and spacing.

rules.name: The Physical Layer Rule
rules.body: A shadow is allowed only when a surface genuinely floats above another interaction layer.

dos: Do use Signal Blue only for primary interaction, focus, selection, and links.
Do pair semantic color with explicit text.
Do preserve keyboard order, accessible names, and translated text lengths.
donts: Don't make Zarya a visual clone of Telegram Desktop.
Don't introduce cyberpunk VPN dashboards, neon gradients, glowing maps, speed gauges, or decorative glass panels.
Don't communicate runtime, warning, or recovery state through color alone.
